crossRefs.note: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”
Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.
I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.
Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and…
Boiling over like water, you shall not excel; because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to…
that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery…
let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.
Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by…
These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm; for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.
These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves…
wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been…

translations.web: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.
translations.bsb: But he must ask in faith, without doubting, because he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, blown and tossed by the wind.
translations.kjv: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
translations.asv: But let him ask in faith, nothing doubting: for he that doubteth is like the surge of the sea driven by the wind and tossed.
